name: Hawke's Bay Regional Council
story: Hawke’s Bay Regional Council used GIS and linked environmental databases for groundwater, river, hazard and resource-management work. The 2006 Heretaunga Steady-State Ground-Water Model credits named database and GIS contributors. The Hawke’s Bay Region GIS Forum reported its use of an Esri platform in 2008.

sources.label: NZEUG GISList discussion, The future of the NZ ESRI User Group Conference, including council and Hawke's Bay regional responses
Hawke's Bay Regional Council, Heretaunga Steady-State Ground-Water Model, HBRC Plan 3765, prepared by Tom Brooks
